_note: New machine: run  python scripts/setup_workspace.py D:/ClipKit  (or pick the workspace in ClipKit Settings); it creates config.json with these paths. Scripts read config.json; never hard-code paths in a skill.
_models_dir_note: speech model (about 3 GB); empty = the default cache on C:, Settings sets it to <workspace>/models
_card_font_note: optional: any installed font, only used for quick preview renders; editors pick their own fonts in CapCut
_envato_backend_note: local = this machine's Chrome via scripts/envato.py (run: python scripts/envato.py login once); bot = team bot on the bot host
